caption: 7.10.3 IOC functionality
rt:
7.9.30 Auto start Objects Before scheduling starts the AUTOSAR Operating System5 activates all auto-start objects that are configured. This mechanism shall work similar on a Multi-Core system. Before scheduling starts, the Multi-Core OS shall activate all configured auto-start objects on the respective core. Due to the fact that OS-Applications are defined as the locatable entity no further configuration container is required. Auto-start objects are already configured as part of an OS-Application. 7.9.30.1 Requirements
[SWS_Os_00668] Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80006
⌈The AUTOSAR Operating System shall automatically activate all auto-start Tasks configured for the current AppMode, with respect to the core, before the initial start of the scheduling.⌋
[SWS_Os_00669] Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80006
⌈The AUTOSAR Operating System shall automatically activate all auto-start Alarms configured for the current AppMode, with respect to the core, before the initial start of the scheduling.⌋
[SWS_Os_00670] Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80006
